title: Do Sharks Sleep? 🦈 #Shorts
description:
Yes — sharks do sleep. Scientists proved draughtsboard sharks truly sleep after just 5 minutes of stillness, even with their eyes open.
Some sharks sleep on the seafloor while others, like the great white, likely sleep while swimming — in 2023 grey reef sharks were caught napping under coral ledges.
OTIS — Dumb questions. Wild answers.
